description.value: The study examined neurocognitive differences and structural brain-volume differences and associations in traumatized adolescents with and without PTSD using voxel-based morphometry and Freesurfer.

spans.text: This study assessed the relationship between neurocognitive deficits and regional brain volumes in traumatized adolescents with and without PTSD.

value: We hypothesized that adolescents with PTSD would have significantly smaller brain volumes in these areas compared to trauma-exposed controls, and that volumetric reductions would be consistent with greater cognitive impairments.
